say:1:1641119001:1.text: These spices are excellent quality... no surprise, coming from Holt Street.
say:1:1641119001:1.source_cn: 这些香料的品质很不错……不愧是霍尔特商街。
say:1:1641119001:1.male: These spices are excellent quality... no surprise, coming from Holt Street.
say:1:1641119001:1.female: These spices are excellent quality... no surprise, coming from Holt Street.

say:2:1641119002:1.text: Take this cedar incense—light one before bed, and it wraps you in calming bliss, like a lullaby made of trees.
say:2:1641119002:1.source_cn: 像这款雪松香，燃起来的时候气息安静沉稳，很适合在夜晚睡...
say:2:1641119002:1.male: Take this cedar incense—light one before bed, and it wraps you in calming bliss, like a lullaby made of trees.
say:2:1641119002:1.female: Take this cedar incense—light one before bed, and it wraps you in calming bliss, like a lullaby made of trees.

say:3:1641119003:1.text: And this one—rose with a hint of citrus. Brightens your mood in refreshingly subtle ways.
say:3:1641119003:1.source_cn: 而这款玫瑰混合柑橘的香气，则让人心情舒展，闻久了也不会腻。
say:3:1641119003:1.male: And this one—rose with a hint of citrus. Brightens your mood in refreshingly subtle ways.
say:3:1641119003:1.female: And this one—rose with a hint of citrus. Brightens your mood in refreshingly subtle ways.

say:4:1641119004:1.text: I might grab a few extra. Maybe bring some back for the Queen.
say:4:1641119004:1.source_cn: 我在想，要不要多买一些，带回去给王后陛下。
say:4:1641119004:1.male: I might grab a few extra. Maybe bring some back for the Queen.
say:4:1641119004:1.female: I might grab a few extra. Maybe bring some back for the Queen.

say:5:1641119005:1.text: She's been knee-deep in court affairs lately. If anything can unravel a royal stress knot, it's this scent.
say:5:1641119005:1.source_cn: 她平日事务繁忙，若是能在休息时闻到这些清新的香味，心情...
say:5:1641119005:1.male: She's been knee-deep in court affairs lately. If anything can unravel a royal stress knot, it's this scent.
say:5:1641119005:1.female: She's been knee-deep in court affairs lately. If anything can unravel a royal stress knot, it's this scent.

say:6:1641119006:1.text: And between you and me... I'll probably keep a couple for myself.
say:6:1641119006:1.source_cn: 顺便我自己也想试一试。
say:6:1641119006:1.male: And between you and me... I'll probably keep a couple for myself.
say:6:1641119006:1.female: And between you and me... I'll probably keep a couple for myself.
